# EffectCraft modules

Unmodified source files from https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft at commit `357b4c5bd531f9032ad6dc02937dcc75ab293ee9` (v0.16.0). Included modules: time, geom, color, keyframe. `UPSTREAM.json` records the original Git blob hashes; all 15 imported files matched the upstream tree on import.

Used under the MIT option, copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the EffectCraft contributors. Full permission/warranty notice: LICENSE-MIT. Workspace dependency declarations are supplied by rust/Cargo.toml. The MapAnimator editor and egui adapter live outside this directory; native engine/project/compositor crates are not vendored.
